name: dispatch-router
description: Asks a TypeSafe model which CLI and model should take each agent task, and refuses an agent launch that was not routed. Needs a TypeSafe API key; without one it does nothing. Sends the task text to api.typesafe.ai.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai. Without it (and without TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the environment) this plugin does nothing.

runners.title: Runners to route between
runners.description: Comma-separated: claude, codex, agy. Name only CLIs you have installed.

claudeModelLow.title: Claude model, cheap tier
claudeModelLow.description: Model name passed to claude --model for mechanical bulk work.

claudeModelMid.title: Claude model, middle tier
claudeModelMid.description: Model name for writing, reviewing and general work.

claudeModelHigh.title: Claude model, top tier
claudeModelHigh.description: Model name for subtle or expensive-to-get-wrong work.

codexModel.title: Codex model
codexModel.description: Model name passed to codex -m. Empty: the launch is matched on the codex command alone.

agyModelLow.title: agy model, cheap tier
agyModelLow.description: Model name passed to agy --model. Empty: matched on the agy command alone.

agyModelHigh.title: agy model, top tier
agyModelHigh.description: Model name for a second opinion from another model family. Empty: matched on the agy command alone.

claudeFlags.title: Extra flags for claude launches
claudeFlags.description: Appended to the launch command shown to you, for example --permission-mode acceptEdits.

codexFlags.title: Extra flags for codex launches
codexFlags.description: Appended to the launch command shown to you, for example -s workspace-write.

agyFlags.title: Extra flags for agy launches
agyFlags.description: Appended to the launch command shown to you.

briefFiles.title: Files codex and agy launches must be pointed at
briefFiles.description: Comma-separated paths. Those CLIs do not load CLAUDE.md on their own, so the brief must name these files.

allowCloud.title: Allow cloud sessions
allowCloud.description: On: the router may send a Claude task to a claude --cloud session. Off: every task stays local.

localOnlyPattern.title: Local-only pattern
localOnlyPattern.description: Regular expression. A task or path that matches it is never sent to the cloud.
